_about: Queue settings for pull_queues.py --state MS. name is the State/Province value in the GEM export; markets are the queues read; owner is the transmission owners or utilities whose state-blank MISO entries are this state's (kept as leads, fuel unknown); shared_owner is owners that also serve other states (their blank entries are counted, not kept); pjm_states is the PJM State values kept; known is hand-checked patterns, GEM plant id to regexes that name that plant in a point of interconnection, project name or developer. Every match still says check.
